title: build.rolled_back@1
description: A promotion's build didn't come up, didn't stay up or misjudged the health check's fixture claim, and the last good build came back (#1334): the one notice, recorded by the build that came back.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Who wrote it, from the connection: the core, at the CLI's `deep hub promote`.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

commit.description: The promoted commit, whose build was rolled back.

restored.description: The build that came back: its folder under versions/, the commit a promoted build is named by.

why.description: Why the build was rolled back: it didn't answer, didn't stay up, or read the fixture claim wrong.
